title: Drag parts client sided PC ONLY
features: (PC ONLY) Drag and delete parts with the gears that apear in the inventory like misplacing walls and stuff (other players wont be able to see the changes you make)
script:
Grab = Instance.new("HopperBin", game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack)
Grab.BinType = Enum.BinType.Grab
Grab.TextureId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=270648006"

SmallScaleGrab = Instance.new("HopperBin", game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack)
SmallScaleGrab.BinType = Enum.BinType.GameTool
SmallScaleGrab.TextureId = ""
SmallScaleGrab.Name = "Small Scale Grab"

Destroy = Instance.new("HopperBin", game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack)
Destroy.BinType = Enum.BinType.Hammer
